a.d: Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon − muzeum sztuki we francuskim mieście Lyon. Muzeum mieści się w starym klasztorze benedyktynów z XVII i XVIII wieku w pobliżu placu Terreaux.

a.n: Katedra św. Jana Chrzciciela w Lyonie
a.d: Katedra św. Jana Chrzciciela w Lyonie (fr.
a.de: The cathedral is dedicated to St John the Baptist (St Jean-Baptiste) and St Stephen (St Etienne) and has the title of primatiale because the Bishop of Lyon has the honorary title of Primat des Gaules. Built between 1180 and 1480, it is mostly of Gothic style with Romanesque elements; the oldest part

a.d: Place Bellecour – duży plac w Lyonie we Francji. Wymiary placu to 312 m na 200 m i jest największym placem jasnym (tj.
Rzymski amfiteatr u stóp wzgórza Croix-Rousse, część sanktuarium kultu Rzymu i Augusta, w którym zbierało się 60 plemion galijskich. Od 1961 roku jest zabytkiem klasy monument historique.
a.de: This Roman theatre is the place where the first Christian martyrs of Gaul were killed. Documents say that it was the largest theatre in Gaul at that time, but nobody knows exactly how far it extends under the neighbouring buildings, nor what remains from the Roman era after centuries of construction

a.d: Największy park miejski Lyonu, z jeziorem, na którym latem pływa się łódkami, oraz ogrodem botanicznym. W jego środkowej części działa niewielkie, bezpłatne zoo z żyrafami, jeleniami, gadami i naczelnymi.
Plac w centrum Lyonu, na półwyspie między Rodanem a Saoną, graniczący z ratuszem i Musée des Beaux-Arts. Leży w strefie wpisanej na listę światowego dziedzictwa UNESCO.
Siedziba Opéra National de Lyon, otwarta w 1756 roku według projektu Jacques'a-Germaina Soufflota, twórcy paryskiego Panteonu. Gmach przebudował w latach 1985–1993 architekt Jean Nouvel.
a.de: Opposite the City Hall stands the opera house. The 1826 theatre built by Chenavard and Pollet was completely redesigned by Jean Nouvel who kept only the façades and the foyer on the first floor. The building was reopened in 1993. The history of these works was epic: a lot of technical problems occur

a.d: Niewielki rzymski odeon blisko szczytu wzgórza Fourvière, tworzący parę z teatrem antycznym. To jedna z dwóch takich par w Galii, a obiekt wpisano na listę UNESCO w 1998 roku.

Fontanna wyrzeźbiona przez Frédérica Auguste'a Bartholdiego, zrealizowana w 1889 roku i ustawiona na placu Terreaux we wrześniu 1892 roku. Pierwotnie projekt powstał dla placu w Bordeaux, które go nie zrealizowało.

a.h: Church 08:30-18:00 daily, crypt Sat 14:30-17:00, closed in Aug
a.d: Kościół na wzgórzach Lyonu, należący do najstarszych we Francji, nazwany od pierwszego biskupa miasta. Jego krypta pochodzi z IX wieku, a sama świątynia została przebudowana i ukończona w 1830 roku.
a.de: The oldest church in Lyon, and one of the oldest in France. The site is built on a Gallo-Roman necropolis which was in use for centuries, until the Middle Ages. Some sarcophagi from the 5th or 6th century are visible in the courtyard. The crypt dates back to the 9th century and was renovated in the

The majestic Hôtel-Dieu was the oldest hospital in Lyon and is one of the largest buildings in Presqu'île. The façade along the river Rhône is over 300 m (984 ft) long. The first hospital was built in 1184-1185; it was modified several times before Soufflot designed the current building, built from

a.d: Muzeum sztuki współczesnej w dzielnicy Cité Internationale, naprzeciw Parc de la Tête d'Or. Statut muzeum sztuki współczesnej otrzymało w 1988 roku, a do obecnej siedziby przeniosło się w 1995 roku.
a.de: It holds temporary exhibitions of Contemporary Art, and selections from its permanent collection of more than 1,400 works.

a.d: Muzeum w sercu Vieux Lyon, złożone z Muzeum Historii Lyonu i Muzeum Marionetek Świata. Budynek wpisano na listę zabytków w 1920 roku, a po ponad dziesięciu latach remontu wznowił działalność w 2009 roku.
a.de: These museums dedicated to the history of the city and to puppets (like the famous Guignol from Lyon). The building is a magnificent Renaissance palace that is worth a visit. A nice garden and cafe have also been created at the top of the building (free access). Unfortunately there is no view, howev

a.n: Jardin zoologique de la ville de Lyon

a.d: Muzeum w dwóch osiemnastowiecznych kamienicach w drugiej dzielnicy, założone w 1864 roku. Ma jedną z największych na świecie kolekcji tkanin, liczącą 2 500 000 pozycji z okresu czterech tysięcy lat.

Ogród w dzielnicy Croix-Rousse, ukryty na podwórzu kamienicy przy Grande Rue de la Croix-Rousse. Stworzył go Jules Senis, hiszpański anarchista, kafelkarz i murarz, który uciekł do Francji przed wojną domową.
Jedna z najstarszych ulic Lyonu, pochodząca z czasów rzymskich, łącząca dzielnicę Saint-Vincent z płaskowyżem Croix-Rousse. Początkowo nazywała się Voie du Rhin.

a.de: Next to St Jean cathedral (on the northern side), this small garden shows the remains of the religious buildings which occupied the site before the cathedral was erected. The oldest remains date back to the 4th century (baptistery of the former St Etienne church).

a.d: Dawna giełda Lyonu w Vieux Lyon, zbudowana w latach 1631–1653, a przebudowana w latach 1748–1750 pod kierunkiem Soufflota. Od 1803 roku służy kultowi protestanckiemu.
a.de: This cobblestone pedestrian street is the main axis of the area. It is full of souvenir shops and restaurants mainly intended for tourists. Local people are aware that real good bouchons are extremely rare here. On a sunny Sunday afternoon, it may be hard to walk because of the crowd of both locals
Parallel to Rue St Jean, this street is much more quiet and just as beautiful. It also has a number of restaurants, more expensive than in rue St Jean but, on average, much more worth the money.

The largest square in the area has two remarkable buildings. The Loge du Change, on the west side, was partially built by the great architect Soufflot. It is now a Protestant church known as Temple du Change. It can be visited on Saturdays. Religious services on Sundays, 10:30. Opposite is the Maiso
A very nice church, with mixed Romanesque and Gothic styles. The oldest parts are from the 10th century.

St Georges is the name given to the south part of the Vieux Lyon. It has nice Renaissance buildings which, however, do not really compare to the palaces of St Jean; on the other hand, it is much more quiet than the St Jean area.

a.d: Stara, stroma ulica na wzgórzu Fourvière, między dzielnicami Saint-Jean i Saint-Just. Fourvière zwane jest wzgórzem, które się modli, z powodu bazyliki, klasztorów i rezydencji arcybiskupa.
a.de: This picturesque montée (sloping street on hillside) starts behind Vieux Lyon metro station and ends quite close to the Roman theatres of Fourvière. It was the main link between the river Saône and the top of Fourvière throughout the Roman era, Middle Ages and Renaissance. Nowadays it keeps a mediev

The historical court house, also named "the 24 columns", was built between 1835 and 1842 by architect Louis-Pierre Baltard. It is a fine example of French "neo-classical" architecture. It now hosts only the criminal court (Cour d'Assises) and the court of appeal. The other jurisdictions moved to a n

a.d: Bazylika Notre-Dame de Fourvière – bazylika w Lyonie, znajdująca się na szczycie wzgórza Fourvière. Wybudowana z prywatnych funduszy między 1872 i 1896.
a.de: Built in 1872 and dedicated to the Virgin Mary, patron saint of Lyon, this massive church made of white marble has been compared to an elephant with its feet up. It is a typical example of the 19th century "eclectic" style, with architectural elements recalling antique, classical and Gothic eras. Th

a.h: Daily 10:00-12:30 and 14:00-17:30, closed in January and February
a.de: The small museum holds treasures donated to the church for its construction.

Next to the basilica is the panoramic viewpoint, with the best view over the city. If the weather is clear, Mont Blanc can be seen in the distance. This is a very good point to start your visit of the city because you can really see its general layout.

a.d: Stalowa wieża z lat 1892–1894, przypominająca wieżę Eiffla, która powstała trzy lata wcześniej. Waży 210 ton, a do 1953 roku służyła jako wieża widokowa.
a.de: Next to the basilica stands a smaller (86 m, 282 ft) replica of the Eiffel Tower, completed in 1894. Its construction was supported by anticlerical people in order to have a non-religious building as the highest point in Lyon, which it actually is with an altitude of 372 m (1272 ft) at the top. It n

a.d: Rzymski teatr na wzgórzu Fourvière, w sercu starożytnego miasta, budowany w dwóch etapach od około 15 roku przed naszą erą. Po rozbudowie z początku II wieku miał średnicę 108 metrów i 10 tysięcy miejsc.
a.de: These two well-preserved theatres are the most important remnant of the Roman city of Lugdunum. The Gallo-Roman museum was built next to them. The summer festival "Nuits de Fourvière" takes place here every year, which may cause access restrictions in the evening from June to early August.
19th-century Romanesque church unique for not having a front entrance due to construction conflicts with the barracks across the street.

a.d: Stroma i w dolnej części wąska ulica w dzielnicy Croix-Rousse, łącząca dzielnicę Terreaux z płaskowyżem Croix-Rousse. Należy do strefy wpisanej na listę światowego dziedzictwa UNESCO.
a.de: This steep street has Renaissance buildings and offers a very beautiful view over the city from its top.
This painted wall is dedicated to the history and typical architecture of the Croix-Rousse hill.

a.d: Do rewolucji francuskiej kościół lyońskiej kartuzji, poświęcony świętemu Brunonowi z Kolonii. Jest jedynym barokowym kościołem w mieście.
a.de: The only Baroque church in Lyon. The interior is magnificent, especially the altar (by Servandoni, modified by Soufflot, 18th century) and the canopy (by Servandoni).

The city hall, built in the 17th century, has a very beautiful façade on Place des Terreaux. The most notable feature of this façade is the sculpture representing King Henri IV on horseback (in the middle of the upper part). Unfortunately, it is impossible to visit the building except during the "He
This impressive painted wall portraits some of the most famous people who were born in Lyon, from Renaissance poet Louise Labé to the Lumière brothers, the inventors of cinema, to chef Paul Bocuse.

a.d: Kościół na półwyspie, między placami Terreaux i Jacobins, zaczęty w XIV wieku, a ukończony dopiero w XIX wieku. Łączy neogotycką iglicę z renesansową fasadą i od 1998 roku figuruje na liście UNESCO.
a.de: Very nice church of flaming Gothic style.

This cobblestone pedestrian street is the only significant remain from the Renaissance in Presqu'île. The name of the street refers to the clothing industry. There are traboules connecting the street to the buildings on the Saône bank. The street hosts very numerous restaurants which are far from be

The state of this square is typical of the "automobile-friendly" urban planning of the 1960s: it is covered with tarmac, too much so given the reasonable traffic around it. A renovation project is under way, which should give the square a greener aspect. The main interest is the central fountain (18

a.d: Romański kościół w dzielnicy Ainay na półwyspie Presqu'île, uznawany za wzorcowy przykład architektury romańskiej. Wraz z innymi budowlami centrum Lyonu wpisano go na listę światowego dziedzictwa UNESCO.
a.de: The only entirely Romanesque church in Lyon, dating back to the 11th-12th centuries. The abbey of Ainay was one of the most powerful in France between the 13th and the 16th centuries. A must-see for its very nice atmosphere.

A boat trip can be a good way to see Lyon from a different point of view. Boats will take you either upstream to Ile Barbe or downstream to the Confluence. Night trips available on Fridays and Saturdays.

This business and residential area in an important urban project for Lyon. Designed by the famous Italian architect Renzo Piano (also known for Beaubourg modern art centre in Paris and part of the Potsdamer Platz area in Berlin), it comprises a convention centre, hotels and luxury apartments just be

This neighbourhood was built by the famous local architect Tony Garnier in the 1920s to house industry workers. Along with Edouard Herriot hospital, it is one of the masterpieces of this visionary architect. The main axis of the neighbourhood, boulevard des États-Unis, was named to honour the United

a.d: Wyspa pośrodku Saony, w dziewiątej dzielnicy Lyonu. Jej nazwa wywodzi się od łacińskiego insula barbara, czyli wyspa barbarzyńców, co sugeruje, że zasiedlono ją jako jedną z ostatnich.
a.de: This charming island on the river Saône is the only inhabited island in Lyon. In the 5th century, one of the first monasteries in Gaul was founded there. It became a powerful Benedictine abbey (from the 9th century) but was finally ruined in 1526 by Protestants, during the religious wars. Of the thr

The neighbouring city of Villeurbanne can be seen as the 10th arrondissement because the urban continuity with Lyon is obvious. It has, however, a strong identity of its own. As an industrial town, Villeurbanne has always had a very strong left-wing political inclination. It was governed by the Comm

a.n: Palais Saint-Pierre / Musée des Beaux Arts
a.h: Mon Wed Thu Sat 10:00-18:00, Fri 10:30-18:00, partial closures 12:00-14:15, ticket office closes 17:30

a.n: Institut Lumière - Musée vivant du Cinéma
a.h: Tue-Sun 11:00-18:30. Closed 1 Jan, 1 May, and 25 Dec. Open on bank holiday Mondays
a.de: This museum in the Lumière brothers' house presents an interesting history of cinema through various items and film excerpts. Also worth seeing for the lovely architecture.

a.h: Visitor centre: Tue-Sat 14:00-18:00, guided tours Sat at 14:30 or by appointment for groups of 10 or more
a.de: This museum was created during the renovation of the États-Unis neighbourhood in the 1980s and 1990s, and the inhabitants were strongly involved in the project. The museum comprises a recreated apartment of the 1930s, which shows how life was like in these very modern housing units, and the 25 wall

a.n: Centre d'Histoire de la Résistance et de la Déportation
a.d: Muzeum z 1992 roku na terenie dawnej szkoły wojskowej, poświęcone ruchowi oporu i deportacji Żydów. W 1943 roku Klaus Barbie, szef lyońskiego gestapo, torturował tam członków ruchu oporu, w tym Jeana Moulina.
a.de: This museum in the former Gestapo regional headquarters depicts the daily life in Lyon under the German occupation and keeps memories of this tragic period. Often holds exhibitions (mostly photography).

a.n: Musée des Arts Décoratifs et Musée des Tissus
a.h: Closed for renovations until 2024 <!-- Tue-Sun 10:00-12:00, 14:00-17:30, closed on holidays -->
a.de: Great if you are into old European oil paintings, or relocated Egyptian, Greek or Mesopotamian antiquities. An impressively large local numismatic gallery. Housed in an interesting building with a pleasant courtyard. Probably disappointing if you have come from larger museums such as those in Paris,

a.h: Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00, closed 1Jan, 1 May, 1 Nov and 25 Dec
a.de: The second largest museum in France, it has all kinds of things relating to Rhone-Alps history. A free visit to the Roman theatres may be just as interesting for those not into the details.

Created by artist Dan Ohlmann, this private gallery shows about 120 miniature models of all kinds of scenes: houses, restaurants, workshops, schools, etc., from Lyon or elsewhere, historical or contemporary. The accuracy of the models is astonishing and some sections will be real fun for children. M

An excellent collection of some facets of printing. The collection features some particularly early works and a reasonable amount of supporting material. Unfortunately, the collection is quite biased towards local Lyonnaise history and thus coverage of printing as an art remains regrettably rather s

a.d: Centrum naukowe i muzeum antropologii, otwarte 20 grudnia 2014 roku na południowym krańcu półwyspu. Stoi w miejscu zbiegu Rodanu i Saony, a nazwę nosi od tego położenia.
a.de: The spectacular building at the confluence of the Rhône and the Saone is built in a deconstructionist style and has expositions on science and mythology.

The Rhône banks promenade ends here. This park does not have the majesty of Parc de la Tête d'Or but it is far less crowded and boasts some nice examples of modern landscaping. Still under development, it should cover 80 hectares when completed.
A park built on the grounds of former military barracks. It includes a large skatepark and many sports playgrounds. Still under development, it should cover 17 hectares when completed.

This park between the metal tower of Fourvière and the Loyasse cemetery is a promenade with a nice footbridge offering great views towards the Monts d'Or and Beaujolais. There is an aerial adventure course and a skiing and mountain bike slope.

Small garden hidden in the bottom of a street/car park, behind a metallic door. It was designed by Canadian artists in a surrealistic spirit (recalls Magritte or Dali). Also a very nice viewpoint over the southern part of Lyon.

Successful on the soccer field but massively in debt, so OL were relegated in 2025 to Ligue 2, the second tier. The stadium (capacity 59,000) is in the suburb of Décines 15 km east of city centre. The women's team is also badly in debt but continues to play in their top tier.
The Villeurbanne basketball team has a long history as one of the major clubs in the country.

The rugby team of Lyon has bounced between the top two levels of the country's league system (Top 14 and Pro D2) in the 2010s; they have played in Top 14 since 2016–17. The team moved to OL's former home of Stade de Gerland for 2017–18.

a.d: Muzeum cywilizacji galijsko-rzymskiej w budynku Bernarda Zehrfussa, otwartym w 1975 roku obok rzymskiego teatru i odeonu na Fourvière. Wnętrze tworzy betonowa spiralna rampa opadająca do sal wystawowych.
Dawny magazyn cukru z 1930 roku nad Saoną w dzielnicy Confluence, od 2003 roku odnowiony na miejsce wystaw sztuki współczesnej. Jest główną siedzibą Biennale Sztuki Współczesnej.
Ciąg parków, nabrzeży i ścieżek spacerowych wzdłuż Rodanu, urządzony w latach 2005–2007 na dziesięciu hektarach. Biegnie od Parc de la Tête d'Or do Parc de Gerland.
